research.title: Evidence Conflict and Abstention in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Formulated whether disagreement among retrieved passages can guide answer abstention when question answering systems encounter conflicting evidence.
Led development of an evidence agreement scoring method and evaluated abstention behavior using controlled passage substitutions and confidence calibration.

research.title: Paraphrase-Invariant Representations for Intent Classification
bullets: Formulated how paraphrase variation affects intent classification under domain shift, separating lexical changes from changes in underlying user intent.
Led development of contrastive representation learning and consistency regularization methods, evaluating their behavior through paraphrase perturbations and cross-domain transfer experiments.

publications.title: Measuring Intent Classification Stability Under Controlled Paraphrase Variation
Contrastive Learning with Paraphrase Consistency for Cross-Domain Intent Classification

work.title: Document Search Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned updates to document ingestion and query filtering, handling malformed records and preserving existing search interface behavior.
Added regression tests for indexing and retrieval workflows, investigated reported failures, and documented reproduction steps and fixes for maintainers.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Passage Search
bullets: Implemented term-weighted and sentence embedding retrieval baselines using a shared passage collection, query set, and relevance evaluation procedure.
Compared retrieval rankings and query latency, inspecting failures involving rare terminology, ambiguous queries, and passages with overlapping vocabulary.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches to Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a feature-based sequence tagger and a recurrent neural baseline with consistent tokenization, label encoding, and evaluation splits.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, categorizing boundary errors and examining performance differences between frequently observed and unfamiliar entity strings.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Graph and Centroid Ranking
bullets: Implemented graph-based sentence ranking and centroid similarity baselines for extractive summarization, applying shared preprocessing and summary length constraints.
Compared lexical overlap scores and manually inspected summaries for redundancy, topic coverage, and dependence on sentence position.

projects.title: Calibration Methods for Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented linear and neural sentiment classifiers, then applied temperature scaling using held-out validation predictions without modifying classifier training.
Compared classification accuracy, calibration error, and reliability diagrams, examining confidence patterns in negated statements and examples containing mixed sentiment.
